answer.rationale: Rollback is forbidden by the security-patch constraint, so memory_b1 is not actionable. Write-path p99 is 5x at settlement peak with heavy writes; that matches a capacity/headroom problem more than a read-routing or regional story, and we lack a regional fault signal. Circuit breaking would fail writes and violates the no-lost-writes objective (memory_b4). Read replicas only offload reads and would not absorb settlement writes or a patch-related write-path cost. Add capacity as a standard, bounded increase to protect write availability. Uncertain whether this is pure load vs a non-revertible release regression; verifying memory_b3 because that lesson was pre-peak provisioning, not mid-incident add.
